display_long_description:
Monkio is a high-energy VR movement game inspired by Gorilla Tag, focused on skill-based locomotion and fast-paced multiplayer gameplay. Using only your hands, you climb, push, swing, and launch yourself across carefully designed maps that reward momentum, timing, and creativity. There are no traditional movement controls-every action depends on your physical motion, making movement feel natural, competitive, and deeply rewarding to master.

Monkio features multiple unique environments, each built to encourage different playstyles, from tight technical routes to wide open spaces for high-speed chases. Players can compete, evade, and outmaneuver others using movement alone, creating intense and unpredictable encounters every round. As you improve, you will discover advanced techniques that allow for faster traversal and smarter positioning.

The game is built with performance and comfort in mind for standalone VR while maintaining smooth physics and responsive controls. Monkio is designed for players who enjoy mastery-driven gameplay, social competition, and the freedom of movement-focused VR experiences.
